items.title: Is International Paper’s Scale Now Limiting Capital Allocation Effectiveness And Profitability Potential (IP)?
items.summary: Recent research on International Paper highlights that its large scale may now be a constraint, with below-average revenue growth, falling earnings per share and weaker returns on invested capital suggesting past and current investments have not translated into stronger performance. This has raised fresh questions about the effectiveness of management’s capital allocation and the company’s ability to reinvigorate profitability after earlier spending and footprint changes. items.title: IONQ Stock Surges On Tech Wins, But The Heavy Burn Persists
items.summary: IonQ (IONQ) shares rose 9.5% on Thursday, closing at $40.34 after six sessions that had mostly gone the other way. The reason on offer was research: quantum algorithms running inside mainstream engineering software, developed with Synopsys, sped up complex industrial design by up to 14.6%. That is genuine progress. It is also not a sale, and the price you pay for IonQ already assumes a great many sales.
